title: Strict transition augmentation and chain-map identities
statement: For every complex P of completed integral sheaves, the maps u_n of [def-trf-point-transport-strict-quotient-models] satisfy Gamma(t_n) followed by u_n = u_(n+1) followed by Gamma(v_n), and Gamma(r_n) followed by u_n = sigma_P followed by Gamma(theta_n). For every chain map f:P->P', Gamma(f_n) followed by u_n(P') = u_n(P) followed by Gamma(g_n^* f_n). The maps t_n,v_n,r_n,theta_n are the actual coefficient transitions, pulled-back transitions, quotient units and inverse-image reduction comparisons of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] and [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. No flatness or constructibility is needed for these strict identities.

proof.text: Evaluate the section formula [lem-trf-point-transport-strict-quotient-sections]. The pullback transition is prescribed on the adjunction-unit generators. Its naturality under the comma-arrow restriction and naturality of the quotient transition give the first identity. For augmentation use the integral sigma formula, the theta formula, restriction naturality of the quotient unit, and its pure-tensor formula. For a chain map use restriction naturality and naturality of the pullback adjunction unit. Equality of sections in each degree implies equality of complex maps.

theorem strictQuotientPointMap_identities :
    (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
    ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).app P) ≫
        strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P =
      strictQuotientPointMap D l E (n + 1) P ≫
        ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          ((integralOperationsPullbackTransition l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n).app P)) ∧
    (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
    ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (unrestrictedTowerUnit l E (Spec (.of D.k)) P n) ≫
        strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P =
      frobeniusPointIntegralSigma D l E P ≫
        ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (inverseImageReductionTheta l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n P)) ∧
    (∀ (P P' : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ)
    (f : P ⟶ P') (n : ℕ),
    ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).map f) ≫
        strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P' =
      strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P ≫
        ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          ((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n).map f))
